transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’m here because after I have these eating episodes, I feel really gross and disappointed in myself. Like I should’ve had more control. I’ve been writing some pretty awful things about myself in my journal afterward, and… yeah, it’s been bothering me.
Can you tell me more about what you mean by 'these eating episodes'?

Um… it’s usually after my cleaning shift, some nights. I’ll stop at the convenience store meaning to just get dinner, but then I end up buying a lot. Like ramen, a few rice balls, fried chicken, sweets… and I’ll eat it in my room pretty quickly, within like an hour or two. It feels like… more than I meant to eat.
Do you ever make yourself vomit or try to get rid of the food after one of these eating episodes?
Um… I don’t really know. I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t… done anything like that on purpose after.
How often do these eating episodes happen?
Usually… at least once a week, I think. It’s been like that for a few months. I don’t really remember it stopping for more than maybe a week.
Do you feel like you have control over what you're eating or how much you're eating during these episodes?

Not really… once I start, it’s like I just keep picking up the next thing without thinking much. Even if I’m telling myself, like, “Fumi, stop, you have sketches to finish,” I don’t really stop until it’s gone, or I feel too full.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over the past few months?
I’m not really sure. I don’t weigh myself much… my clothes maybe feel a little different sometimes, but I haven’t really tracked it.
Do you usually feel guilty after these eating episodes?

Yeah… I do. I feel really gross after, and kind of… disappointed in myself. Like I should’ve been able to control it. Sometimes I end up writing pretty awful things about myself in my journal afterward.
Have you noticed any periods where you lost a lot of weight, followed by periods where you gained it back?
Um… not that I’ve really noticed. I don’t track my weight much, so I can’t say for sure, but I don’t think there’s been anything like a big loss and then gaining it all back.
Do you engage in any form of exercise or physical activity to try to burn off calories after one of these eating episodes?
Not really… I mean, I’m on my feet a lot at work, but I don’t usually go exercise after or anything like that.
Do you ever fast or severely restrict your food intake after one of these eating episodes?
Um… no, not really. I might not feel like eating much right after, but I don’t think I, like, fast on purpose or anything.
Do you typically eat alone during these episodes?
Um… I guess sometimes, yeah. I don’t really think about it that much, but I’m usually by myself if it happens.
Have these eating episodes been happening for more than three months?

Yeah… it’s been more than three months. For a while now, most weeks there’s at least one night after work where I buy too much food and just… eat it all. I don’t think it’s stopped for more than maybe a week.
Have you had these eating episodes at least once a week for the past three months?
Yeah… I think so. Most weeks, there’s at least one night after work where I buy too much and end up eating all of it. I can’t really think of a recent month where it stopped for more than a week.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
I don’t know… I mean, I don’t like the idea, but I’m not sure I’d say I’m afraid of it.
Do you ever use laxatives or diuretics after eating?
No… I don’t use those after eating.
Do you feel like you're eating really quickly during these episodes?
Yeah… I do. I eat really fast, like I’m just trying to get it down before I think too much. Sometimes I’m just standing at the counter or sitting on my bed, and I barely even taste it.
Have you experienced any noticeable swings in your weight, where you've lost weight and then gained it back over the past few months?
I’m not really sure. I don’t weigh myself much, so… I haven’t noticed anything big like that.
Are you afraid of gaining weight or becoming fat?
I don’t know… not really in a clear way. I don’t like thinking about my weight, but I’m not sure I’d call it being afraid.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
I… I don’t think so. I don’t like the idea of it, but I wouldn’t say I’m really afraid of it.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
I guess… no, not exactly. It’s not something I’d say I’m afraid of.
